test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Fish live in aquariums and pigs live in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**sties**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**sties**" refers to enclosures or pens where pigs are kept.
 
• Fish live in aquariums as a controlled environment for aquatic life.
 
• Pigs live in sties, which are suitable areas for their habitation.
 
• The other options: "**stables**," "**dens**," and "**kennels**" do not fit the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Fish live in aquariums and pigs live in sties__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Stables**: are used to house horses or cattle.
 
• **Dens**: refer to shelters for wild animals like lions and bears.
 
• **Kennels**: are shelters for dogs.
